content:
Will {C}ye gang to the highlands, Leezie {A}Lindsay?
Will ye {C}gang to the highlands with {F}me?
{G}Will ye {C}gang to the highlands, Leezie {a}Lindsay?
Me {F}bride and me {G}darling to {C}be?

If I gang to the highlands with you, Sir,
I don't think that ever could be!
For I know not the land that you live in,
nor knowing the name you go with.

O lass, I think you know a little
if you say that you don't know me.
For me name is Lord Ronald McDonald,
a chieftain of high degree.

So she's kilted up her skirts of green satin
and she's kilted them up around her knee.
And she's gone with Lord Ronald McDonald
his bride and his darling to be.
title: Leezie Lindsay
